column1: # Cipher between the Count of Mansfeld and the Duke of Feria (1593), used also by Don Diego de Ibarra
# in Paris. Key published by S. Tomokiyo, cryptiana "Spanish Ciphers during the Reign of Philip II",
# image spanish3mansfeld.png. Cited by him at BnF fr. 3984 ff. 130, 145. A DIFFERENT numbering from the
# 1592-93 cipher of key92.tsv. Letters: a=x/2, e=p/3, o=r, u=n, y=d-stroke; "de"=8.
# Marks: ~ doubling consonant, + final -l, v final -n, . final -r, ° final -s,
#        bar = number per se, infinity = -l-, + = -r-, r = -h-
